Dar chhote patharon se pahaad bana deta hai.
Khamoshi aksar sabse khatarnak jawab hoti hai.
Dimaag ek samrajya hai jo girne ka intezaar kar raha hai.
Gehre andhere mein taare sabse jyada chamkate hain.
Chalak dimaag qabr mein bhi roshni dhoondh leta hai.
Har deewar ek intezaar karti darwaaza hai.
Gyaani moorh ki bhi sune.
Dimaag ek jahaj hai jo anjaane samandar par chalta hai.
Wada karne mein dheere, nibhane mein tez bano.
Dimaag wahan jaata hai jahan pair nahi chal sakte.
Satya ko kisi bhesh ki aavashyakta nahi.
Teekhi baat buddhi ki talwar hai.
Hosh arajakta ke sath ek nazuk samjhauta hai.
Satya bina baisakhi ke chale.
Gyaani poore vishwa ka naagrik hai.
Dar tark ki aankh ko andha kar deta hai.
Jo ek hi patthar par do baar thokar khaaaye, vah moorh hai.
Dard wo sikhata hai jo darshan nahi sikha sakta.
Gyaani apane vichaaron mein khush rehta hai.
Man chhaaiyon ka rangmanch hai.
Shanti shant vichaaron ki fasal hai.
Hansi dukh ki kshanik mrityu hai.
Rooh tab sunti hai jab duniya shaant hoti hai.
Jo khud ki seva kare, uska maalik bura hota hai.
Moorh shor khoje; gyaani gahrai khoje.
Buddhi zameen khojti hai, dil unhe aabaad karta hai.
Hansi lohe jaise man ko theek kare.
Teekhi jeebh do-dhaari talwar hai.
Tez jeebh apane hi maalik ko kaate.
Dimaag ki khai sabse ujjwal ummeedo ko nigal ti hai.
Teekhi dhaar dushman aur dost dono ko kaat ti hai.
Anand saral saans mein mile.
Gyaani jeevan ke ant ko dekhe.
Shaant paani anant ko pratibimbabit kare.
Buddhi andar ki divya aag ki chingari hai.
Log ahankar ke uthle paani me doobte hain.
Dar kaagaj ke bagh hain.
Ek chatur baat moorkh din ko sudhar deti hai.
Man apani pinjara banata hai, phir rota hai.
Kadva dil apne hi kuen ko zehrila karta hai.
Shaant aatma ek durg hai.
Gyaani hasta hai jahan moorkh rota hai.
Buddhi kadve imtihaanon ka meetha phal hai.
Teekhi buddhi sabse bhaari kavach ko hara deti hai.
Dil tark ki koi sarhad nahi jaanta.
Ek prasann baat sabse andhere hisse ko roshan karti hai.
Gyaan chhupi hui sone se behtar hai.
Insaani bhulbhulaiya ki koi master key nahi hai.
Hum aakash napte hain, par zameen par thokar khate hain.
Ek teekhi baat vichar ka gehna hai.
